title: Edge Detection
text: 使用 Sobel、Prewitt、Roberts 或 Canny 方法查找图像中对象的边缘，输入 2 路、输出 5 路；按 {Method} 指定边缘检测方法；{Output Type} 输出图像类型 Binary、{User-defined threshold}、{Threshold source}、{Threshold} 指定阈值、{Threshold, [Low High]} 指定 Canny 边缘检测的阈值、{Threshold scale factor:(used to automatically calculate threshold value)} 指定阈值缩放因子、{Edge Thinning} 指定边缘细化、{Approximate percentage of weak edge and nonedge pixels (used to automatically calculate threshold values)} 指定弱边缘和非边缘像素的近似百分比、{Standard deviation of Gaussian filter} 指定高斯滤波器的标准差，按实例取值。

ports.name: Gv

ports.summary: 对水平边缘的梯度响应 matrix

ports.summary: 对 45 度边缘的梯度响应 matrix

ports.name: G135

params.name: Method
params.values: 边缘检测方法 Sobel (default) | Prewitt | Roberts | Canny

params.name: Output Type
params.values: 输出图像类型 Binary image (default) | Gradient components | Binary image and gradient components

params.name: Threshold source
params.values: Threshold source Input port (default) | Specify via dialog

params.name: Threshold, [Low High]
params.values: Canny 边缘检测的阈值 [0.25 0.60] (default) | vector

params.name: Threshold scale factor:(used to automatically calculate threshold value)
Approximate percentage of weak edge and nonedge pixels (used to automatically calculate threshold values)
params.values: 弱边缘和非边缘像素的近似百分比 70 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation of Gaussian filter
params.values: 高斯滤波器的标准差 1 (default) | scalar
